	<h1>Military <a name='Nirrum's Encyclopedia of Varomar:Group Patrons:Military'></a></h1>
	</div>

	<div class='content'>
	<p>
Created Sunday 15 October 2023
</p>

<br>

<p>
<b>Title 3: Konian Military</b>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
The remains of the Konian military is barely held together by surviving commanders who have to politically scheme in order to remain supported by taxes from Konia's Outlier colonies now that Konia itself is but a shell of what it once was <b>5854: Not Even a Shell.</b><br>
But people loyal to the old crown, or people loyal to Konia's people still sign on with the military, both for coin, social advancement, vengeance, and the promise of a way to vent frustration.
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<i><b>Guildhall</b></i>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
There is no singular guildhall for the Konian Military, but the Home of its navy is in topside Cer-mina, and Barracks exist in every town within its traditionally taxed territory from Mokoi Tha'am to the Ysterports to Quire. Previously the greater walls of Konia were lined with such forts and towers, but after the war of ants, most of those are rubble.
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<i><b>Memberships</b></i><br>
Generals, Knights, commanders
</div>
</p>

<p>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<i><b>Allies</b></i>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
No specific force is allied with the remains of the Konian Military
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<i><b>Enemies</b></i>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
<b>The Kholirahi Army</b> agresses the northern territories, enslaving the entire north coast, now named the coast of ruins. <br>
<b>Manaharahi Military</b> groups also caused the near complete destruction of Konia's capital and the majority of its military outposts in the south. <b>5854: Not even a shell</b><br>
<b>Monsters. </b>Oh god, so many monsters
</div>
</p>

<br>
<br>

<p>
<b>Title 2: Patron benefits</b><br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Salary and Compensation. </b>
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 60pt'>
<i>Konia Army.</i> 5sp per day for the lowest ranks, 100gp per day for the highest. Those ordained as Knights also obtain rights to a portion of harvest and taxes within their territory, as well as frequently being gifted a house, fort, tower, as part of their domain. Knights claim any treasure they wish from the defeat of any monsters.<br>
<i>Manaharamu Army. </i>1g per day for the lowest ranks, 75gp per day for the highest, along with Semi-yearly options to recieve additional magical items.<br>
<i>Kholirahi Military. </i>1s per day for the lowest ranks, 50gp per day for the highest. Promise of Godhood.<br>
<i>Danzuishan military. </i>2g per day, 200gp per day for the highest, and commission for each mission and campaign. Occasionally comes with titles, Accolades, and networking opportunities. <br>
<i>Skalmirthon</i>. 10g per day for the lowest ranks. 50gp for the highest. Fully customised nonmagical kit, better, customised accomodations, meals, decorations, occasional upgrades to magic items<br>
<i>Kara</i>'<i>ite</i>. 10gp per day for the lowest ranks, up to 500gp per day for the highest ranks. Right to portion of plunder of enemy ships
</div>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
<b>Accomodation. </b>You can always find a place to sleep within a fortification controlled by your military<br>
<b>Chain of Command</b><br>
<b>Orders</b>
</div>
</p>
